text: I see them. Shuri, save the survey. We’re switching to rescue.

text: Your flight recordings are clean enough to isolate the surface.

text: This is not just a light in the atmosphere. There are surface features—and artificial lights.

text: People?

text: The evidence supports that.

text: Then protecting our world doesn’t mean treating theirs as an enemy.

text: We’ve been answering the same emergency from different directions. That changes now.

text: Protect people while we investigate.

text: The timing matches.

text: Agreed.

text: I’ll work on keeping this channel open.
